title: Learning Support: Context and Key Issues
description: An introductory overview of key issues in learning support. Topics include the organization, administration and management of classrooms in which students with special educational needs are found; the referral process; teacher responsibilities for students with special educational needs in the context of regular classrooms; and the utility and limitations of various assessment techniques.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ED-D 420, EDUC 420.
May be offered in French, only for students in a French cohort.
